extension.summary: Infinity Hook API, Skin API, Adaptive Layout API and Skin Theme Contract.
extension.description: Provides Infinity Hook API 1.0, Infinity Skin API 1.0, native-responsive Adaptive Layout API 1.2 and Skin Theme Contract 1.1. Layout/theme publication is generic for Infinity-aware skins. Legacy Xenon file reassertion remains separately gated to Xenon so an Infinity-owned skin/player is never rewritten by the compatibility guard.
